title: Shared board feeder with waiters
spec: Add src/venue/feeder.ts: BoardFeeder({ client, room, wait, limit, sleep }) with subscribe(pred, { deadlineMs, collect? }): Promise<Hit|null>. One long-poll loop per feeder serves every subscriber (before this, each deal polled on its own and a node of 8 agents blew the 600 reads/min cap). The loop runs only while subscribers exist, pages forward with readForward, decodes tclk frames with tryDecodeFrame, calls collect(message) for non-frame lines, resolves a waiter when pred(frame, message) is true and the message is venue-verified (from === frame.from and sig present), and resolves null at the deadline. Errors from read() back off via sleep and never end the loop.
done: Two subscribers over one recorded board each get their frame from a single sequence of reads and a third times out with null.
